_note: One entry per error code. `enforced` = a checker emits it today (and test:negative must have a fixture for it). Others are reserved for the stage in `stage`.

CHAR_FORBIDDEN.summary: A character that is not allowed in copy.
CHAR_FORBIDDEN.why: Emoji and invisible characters break the style or hide from review; other scripts render in a fallback font; * _ ~ are read as tone markup.
CHAR_FORBIDDEN.fix: Delete the character. Plain Latin letters (accents allowed), digits and punctuation are fine.

PHRASE_FORBIDDEN.summary: A phrase from contract/forbidden.json appears in a phrase.
PHRASE_FORBIDDEN.why: Repo rules: no news or source quotes on screen, no price or result promises, no framing marketplaces as something to leave.
PHRASE_FORBIDDEN.fix: Rewrite the phrase. The error's hint says what to say instead.

NUMBER_NOT_IN_BRIEF.summary: A number on screen is not in the approved brief's number table.
NUMBER_NOT_IN_BRIEF.why: Numbers are claims. Each one must be listed with a source or the word Contoh before it can appear.
NUMBER_NOT_IN_BRIEF.fix: Delete the number, or add it to section 5a of the brief and have the brief approved again. The label Contoh does not legalise an unlisted number.

LINEBREAK_FORBIDDEN.summary: A text string contains a line break.
LINEBREAK_FORBIDDEN.why: Lines are array entries in the spec, never \n inside a string.
LINEBREAK_FORBIDDEN.fix: Split into separate entries of the phrase's line array.

ACCENT_INVALID.summary: More than one accent segment in a phrase.
ACCENT_INVALID.why: Reel01 puts the point of a phrase in one accent segment. Two accents dilute it.
ACCENT_INVALID.fix: Keep one segment with tone accent per phrase; make the other strong or quiet.

PRESET_VIOLATION.summary: The spec's structure does not match the reel01-pov-v1 preset.
PRESET_VIOLATION.why: The preset fixes the scene order and the number of phrases per slot; the spec only fills slots. Also covers unknown keys (position, colour, easing) and phrases over the word, line or segment limits.
PRESET_VIOLATION.fix: Match the shape in src/reels/contract/spec.schema.json. Remove keys that are not in it.

CONTRACT_MISMATCH.summary: contractVersion differs from the contract in the repo.
CONTRACT_MISMATCH.why: A spec written for another contract version may mean something different.

ID_INVALID.summary: The spec id is not a valid slug.
ID_INVALID.why: The id names files and folders.
ID_INVALID.fix: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 41 characters.

SCHEMA_INVALID.summary: The spec does not match the schema (wrong type, unknown tone, missing field).
SCHEMA_INVALID.why: The contract is closed: only the listed fields and values exist.

FIT_LINE_OVERFLOW.summary: A line is too wide to read as well as Reel01's text does.
FIT_LINE_OVERFLOW.why: Measured in a real browser with the real fonts; text may not read smaller than the smallest text in Reel01 (contract/fit-limits.json).
FIT_LINE_OVERFLOW.fix: Shorten the copy: fewer words or shorter lines. Never change the layout.

SAFE_ZONE_VIOLATION.summary: Text or a UI element leaves the Reels and TikTok safe zone at some frame.
SAFE_ZONE_VIOLATION.why: Platform UI covers the edges, so anything outside the safe zone can be hidden.
SAFE_ZONE_VIOLATION.fix: Shorten the copy so it fits. Do not change the camera or layout.

HOLD_TOO_SHORT.summary: A sentence is not held on screen long enough.
HOLD_TOO_SHORT.why: Viewers need time to read; the floor is 15 frames, except for the S8 beats that Reel01 itself plays back-to-back (never shorter than Reel01).
HOLD_TOO_SHORT.fix: Fewer words in the phrase, so it settles earlier.

MOTION_BUDGET.summary: More words enter at the same moment than Reel01 ever does.
MOTION_BUDGET.why: Too much simultaneous motion reads as chaos and breaks Reel01's rhythm.
MOTION_BUDGET.fix: Fewer words per phrase. Do not change the timing.

WORD_TIMING_MISMATCH.summary: A phrase has a different number of words than the timing the preset holds for it.
WORD_TIMING_MISMATCH.why: Until timing comes from the voice-over cues (Stage E), each phrase's word times are fixed to Reel01's recording, one time per word.
WORD_TIMING_MISMATCH.fix: Keep the same number of words in that phrase as the golden spec.

NONDETERMINISTIC_API.summary: Code uses Math.random, Date.now, new Date or fetch.
NONDETERMINISTIC_API.why: A render must give the same frames every time; use random(seed) from remotion and local files.
NONDETERMINISTIC_API.fix: Replace with remotion's random(seed) or a constant.

BRIEF_NOT_APPROVED.summary: This reel has no approved brief, or the brief changed after approval.
BRIEF_NOT_APPROVED.why: AGENTS.md rule 0: nothing is built for a reel before its brief is approved.
BRIEF_NOT_APPROVED.fix: Run the grill-reel interview, then npm run approve-brief. Reel01 and golden specs are exempt.

CUE_UNKNOWN.summary: The timing sidecar has a scene, cue or word group the preset does not define, or misses one.
CUE_UNKNOWN.why: Cues come from the recorded voice-over, never typed by hand.
CUE_UNKNOWN.fix: Run reel:cues and have a human confirm it. Do not edit the timing file.

CUE_ORDER.summary: Cues are not in increasing order.
CUE_ORDER.fix: Reorder or correct the cue mapping.

CUE_OUT_OF_RANGE.summary: A cue lies beyond the recording, or the recorded length differs from the timing file.
CUE_OUT_OF_RANGE.fix: Run reel:cues again on the right file.

VO_NOT_NORMALIZED.summary: A voice-over file has not been through reel:vo-prep.
VO_NOT_NORMALIZED.why: All VO is normalised the same way so loudness matches.

ASSET_UNKNOWN.summary: A file sits in a kit asset folder but is not in the manifest.
ASSET_UNKNOWN.why: Assets come from the shared manifest, taken from Reel01's set; models may not create their own.
ASSET_UNKNOWN.fix: Assets come from the manifest (Reel01's set). Models may not add their own; the owner registers new ones with reel:promote-asset.

ASSET_HASH_MISMATCH.summary: A manifest asset's file changed or is missing.
ASSET_HASH_MISMATCH.why: The hash in assets.lock.json no longer matches.

APPROVAL_STALE.summary: Something sealed by the approval has changed since a human approved it.
APPROVAL_STALE.why: The approval seals hashes of the spec, brief, assets, kit, contract, checker scripts and the contact sheet the human looked at. Any change means the human did not approve what would now be rendered.
APPROVAL_STALE.fix: Look at the new contact sheet and approve again with reel:approve (run by a human).

APPROVAL_MISSING.summary: There is no approval for this reel.
APPROVAL_MISSING.why: A render needs an approval sealed by a human after reviewing the contact sheet.
APPROVAL_MISSING.fix: Run reel:check, then reel:stills, then ask a human to run reel:approve.

GATE_NOT_PASSED.summary: A command ran before an earlier gate of the pipeline passed.
GATE_NOT_PASSED.why: The reel moves through fixed gates (brief, spec, check, stills, approval, render). Each command needs the ones before it.
GATE_NOT_PASSED.fix: Do what the message says for the named gate. There is no flag to skip a gate.

TIMING_MISSING.summary: The spec has no timing sidecar (<id>.timing.json).
TIMING_MISSING.why: The kit needs to know which voice-over file each scene uses and when each word is spoken. Those numbers come from the recording, never from a model.
TIMING_MISSING.fix: Record the voice-over, run reel:vo-prep and reel:cues, and have a human confirm the result.

VO_MISSING.summary: A scene's voice-over file is missing or is not a WAV.
VO_MISSING.why: Each of the 14 scenes needs its recording.
VO_MISSING.fix: Put the take in public/reels/<id>/vo-raw/<scene>.wav and run reel:vo-prep.

TIMING_NOT_CONFIRMED.summary: The timing sidecar was not produced by reel:cues and confirmed by a human, or it was changed afterwards.
TIMING_NOT_CONFIRMED.why: Cue and word times come from the recording. A model that types them can invent timing that does not match the voice.
TIMING_NOT_CONFIRMED.fix: Run reel:cues, listen, and have a human run reel:cues --confirm.

VERIFY_DIFF.summary: A re-rendered frame differs from the still a human approved, beyond the measured render noise.
VERIFY_DIFF.why: The approval covers what the human saw. A frame that now looks different is a real change since then. Render noise on this machine is much smaller (PSNR about 51 dB at worst, against 30 dB for a one-word change).
VERIFY_DIFF.fix: Run reel:stills and have the human approve again.

DURATION_EXCEEDED.summary: The reel is 60 seconds or longer.
DURATION_EXCEEDED.why: Reels must be under one minute (AGENTS.md, config/brief-gate.json). Only golden reference specs such as Reel01 are exempt.
DURATION_EXCEEDED.fix: Cut beats or shorten the voice-over. Do not lengthen the reel.
